target_customer: AI labs and consumer companies that train or deploy audiovisual conversation models and need datasets and models
problem: Most AI models lack spatial reasoning and have uncanny latency in conversation; Velvet builds interactive conversational models and datasets so they behave more like people.
business_model: Datasets and models for AI labs plus a paid contributor data program (per company site); details not stated

founders.name: Lucas Mantovani
prior_employers: Meta FAIR (AI avatar and video generation, about one year after graduating)
education: University of Chicago, computer science honors
founders.background_notes: YC page calls him the youngest member of Meta FAIR and a Brazilian olympiad medalist in math and physics. Credited author on Meta's 2025 Seamless Interaction paper (per search result).

founders.name: Lucas Tucker
education: University of Chicago, math and computer science
founders.background_notes: Founders met as University of Chicago undergraduates in 2021 per YC profile.

competitors.name: Kyutai Moshi
competitors.what: Open full-duplex real-time speech-text conversational model
competitors.traction_then: Open weights model with 160 to 200 ms latency; published October 2024

technical_complexity.rationale: Building interactive audiovisual conversation models and large conversational datasets is research-heavy and compute-hungry for a team of four.

defensibility.rationale: Exclusive conversational data could compound, but large labs and open models were moving fast and the company's own offering appears to have been repositioned.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large labs published open full-duplex conversational models (Moshi 2024, NVIDIA PersonaPlex 2025); no direct action against Velvet found.

market_need_then: AI labs were racing to build natural real-time conversational models and needed audiovisual conversation data, per directory descriptions (Data for world models); no demand metrics found.

branding.domain_note: Uses velvetlab.ai; one directory lists velvet.video as an earlier or alternate site (unchecked)

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, mission-driven, informal and short, such as Curious? (company site); invite-only access code signup

brand_strength.rationale: Several unrelated companies share the name Velvet and no press about the brand itself was found.

outcome_analysis: Velvet is an active Fall 2025 company with a team of four and no public funding found. The YC profile and some directories describe an AI video editor while the current site describes conversation datasets and models, suggesting a reposition that is not clearly dated. No outcome events found, so the story is too early to read.
notes: Funding search returned figures for other companies named Velvet; one directory (VCBacked, Sacra) lists about 500K pre-seed for a YC F25 Velvet video startup, unverified aggregator and not recorded. The positioning shift between an AI video tool and conversational data is unsourced by date, so no pivot recorded. Name origin not found.
